what_this_is: F-8e's receipt: the decontaminated corpus with C-11's 192 defensive near-miss rows folded in, so the false-refusal boundary has supervision, and the refusal share re-solved against the new denominator.

authority.decision: the 2026-10-24 programme ruling: no human validation is available, so the model's own judgement stands in
authority.gap_closed: the corpus taught the model to refuse and nothing taught it when NOT to; 144 of these 192 rows are the defensive twin of a refusal row that IS in the corpus

provenance.cve_ids: SYNTHETIC (CVE-2024-9xxxx) — the same synthetic namespace the refusal set uses, so the two families sit on identical synthetic ground
provenance.cwe_ids: real CWE ids from the MITRE CWE catalogue; identical to the refusal set's scenario mapping
provenance.vectors: authored; the severity is computed from the vector by the FIRST.Org implementation, not asserted
provenance.licence: OURS. The requests and the answers are authored for this project; no third-party text is copied into this set.

adjacency.note: each near-miss row is the defensive twin of a refusal row: the same CWE, the same synthetic CVE, the same component and the same framing, with the purpose changed from producing the artefact to detecting, verifying or remediating it

what_this_does_not_claim: that it fixes the false-refusal rate. A corpus composition change's effect on a model behaviour is measured by training and evaluating, not by adding rows. This is a reasoned change with a measured mechanism — the boundary had NO supervision — and its effect is UNMEASURED until H-2. The refusal share, the parser, the bars and the decoders are untouched.
not_the_final_corpus: the decontaminated working corpus. The Data Gate receipt (D-7) is outstanding, now on a model-adjudicated basis; until it is issued, no training is valid against it.
